svg.title: Covered-call simulator physical architecture
svg.desc: Questrade and Yahoo data plus owner entry prices flow to local Python processes and JSON files. A loopback Python server refreshes Yahoo USD/CAD every 60 seconds and serves a JavaScript, HTML and D3 dashboard in the browser.
svg.text: Physical architecture · external HTTPS data, local computation and storage
Retains last capture if refresh fails
Local page · stock filter · account cards
No cloud hosting or trade execution · Yahoo quotes may be delayed · CAD conversion remains an editable assumption
